dcsocial.quote: He rebuilt the entire DC Social Collective website and has been a huge asset in making it more functional and user-friendly. He’s extremely technically skilled, fast, and reliable, and whenever we need something changed or added, he gets it done.
dcsocial.attrib: Christopher Byrne · Founder and President, DC Social Collective

larocca.quote: My website has been transformed thanks to the excellent design and building services of Andrew Likoudis. Any other Catholic creatives looking to build or refresh their online presence should consider his services. The cost was very reasonable and his customer service was exemplary.
larocca.attrib: Frank La Rocca · Composer-in-Residence, Benedict XVI Institute

adan.quote: Andrew’s work reminds me of music composition. Every part of the website he built for me feels chosen with purpose. The result is a site where visitors want to stay a while, because the layout feels natural and intuitive. He works quickly and with real dedication, and he was a joy to work with.

roxane.quote: Andrew was a gem to work with! I’d been putting off updating my website, dreading the weeks it might take to get it right. But Andrew accomplished the goal over a single weekend. Rather than drudgery, the process felt light, even enjoyable. He asked the right questions and applied my vision well, and yes, lickety split. I’m very pleased with the results and would definitely recommend him to other authors and creatives looking for a fresh way to reach their audiences.
roxane.attrib: Roxane B. Salonen · Author, Speaker, Podcast Host

bruna.quote: I’m very happy with the work! Andrew is attentive to every detail and truly dedicated to what he does. The whole process was handled with care, professionalism, and great attention to my needs. It was a pleasure working with him, and I highly recommend his work!

traddyland.quote: Andrew has taken my website to a new level through focused attention to my product and my needs. Well done!

collin.quote: Andrew gets what I’m about and the site shows it. The streaming apps have my music but they’re not mine — this is. My songs, my photos, my label, at my own address. I didn’t lift a finger and it still came out better than if I’d told him what to do.
